matrix.title: Authentic 100 MiB+ SQLite Database Creation, Ingestion & Validation
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Database size >= 100 MiB (104,857,600 bytes) with schema_version=1, required tables and indexes; integrity verification offloaded to worker thread.

matrix.title: 100 MiB+ Dictionary Publication & Atomic Activation
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Database published to custom-snapshots directory with atomic active.json metadata update and successful live lookup queries.

matrix.title: Event-Loop Latency SLA Under 100 MiB+ Database Load
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: P99 event loop lag <= 100 ms; maximum lag <= 500 ms; heartbeat stall < 1000 ms.

matrix.title: Peak Memory Bounded SLA (< 512 MiB Total / < 100 MiB Incremental)
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Peak RSS increment over baseline strictly < 512 MiB; absolute RSS bounded.

matrix.title: Cold Startup Recovery of 100 MiB+ Database Offloaded to Worker
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: DSH restart recovers active 100 MiB+ dictionary with PRAGMA integrity check via companion worker without main-thread blocking; time-to-first-lookup responsive.

matrix.title: Scenario F01: Crash Post-Commit Pre-Ack (Managed ECDICT -> Custom)
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Child process exits (code 101) after writing active.json before IPC ack; on restart, system recovers active Custom mode and reconciles settings.

matrix.title: Scenario F02: Crash Post-Commit Pre-Ack (Custom -> Managed ECDICT)
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Child process exits (code 102) after writing active.json for Managed mode; on restart, recovers Managed ECDICT and reconciles settings.

matrix.title: Scenario F03: Crash Post-Unlink Pre-Ack (Custom -> Fixture)
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Child process exits (code 103) after unlinking active.json; on restart, correctly falls back to Fixture mode without phantom metadata.

matrix.title: Scenario F04: Crash Before Commit Boundary (Durable State Preserved)
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Child process exits (code 104) before active.json atomic rename; on restart, previous active dictionary remains authoritative.

matrix.title: Scenario F05: Crash After Commit Boundary, Pre-Host Config Ack
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Child process exits (code 105) with pending settingsSyncState; on restart, new active snapshot is adopted and settings reconciled to synced.

matrix.title: SnapshotPickerModal Rendering & Listing Both Custom Snapshots (A & B)
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Clicking top Custom button with > 1 valid snapshots opens SnapshotPickerModal displaying both snapshot A and B with distinct rows.

matrix.title: Explicit Snapshot Selection Routing & Real Lexicon Queries
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Clicking select button inside modal for snapshot A activates A with A words found; selecting B activates B with B words found.

matrix.title: Multi-Snapshot Availability & Switching Persistence Across DSH Restart
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Rebooting isolated DSH process preserves active snapshot B; returning to UI allows opening modal and selecting A cleanly.

matrix.title: Inactive Snapshot Deletion With Modal Confirmation & Active Protection
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Deleting inactive snapshot A via UI confirmation modal succeeds and removes row from catalog; active snapshot B remains functional and protected.

matrix.title: User Raw SQLite Source Files SHA-256 Invariance
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Raw user SQLite database files A and B remain strictly unmodified across initial creation, publication, activation, switching, restart, and deletion.

matrix.title: AsyncRecordingLock Concurrency, Exception Boundaries & Idempotency
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: 10 critical concurrency scenarios pass: sequential queue execution, rejection handling, rapid open/close, unmount cleanup, and duplicate release idempotency.

matrix.title: Production Package Surface Strict 8-File Whitelist Audit
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: npm pack tarball contains strictly the 8 approved files and zero test fixtures, corpora databases, or dev scripts.

matrix.title: Security Invariants & Capability Contract Verification
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Zero credentials/tokens, zero lifecycle scripts, zero child_process, zero eval/Function, zero runtime dependencies, zero process.env.

matrix.title: Isolated DSH Profile .tgz Installation, Live Lookup & Clean Uninstall
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Candidate .tgz installs in clean profile; boots DSH, completes live query, renders settings UI, and uninstalls cleanly disarming routes without host crash.

matrix.title: Git SHA Provenance Closure & 100% Regression Suite Pass
matrix.acceptanceCriteria: Historical commit SHA anomaly documented and closed; 60 test files and 1121 tests pass 100% with zero regressions.
